compiled_state.title: Create review-findings-schema.md contract (relation taxonomy)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## test-exempt
Justification: (1) no conditional logic — pure markdown documentation, (2) any test would be a change-detector test only asserting file existence/section presence, (3) documentation artifact with no executable behavior.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD1: relation taxonomy and DefenseStore record shape are documented as canonical contracts that all reviewer agents and orchestrator code reference (relation taxonomy portion)

## What
Create `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md` following the established contract document structure (see escalate-review-signal.md as reference pattern).

## Content Requirements
The contract must define:
1. **Relation enum** — four values with semantics:
   - `NEW_INTRODUCED`: finding on lines in the cycle-N fix delta; no prior finding connection. Unrestricted severity.
   - `NEW_PRE_EXISTING`: finding on pre-existing code not previously flagged. Auto-downgrades to `minor` UNLESS the referenced `prior_finding_id` was previously rated `important` or `critical`.
   - `RESUSTAIN_OF`: re-raises a specific prior finding by `prior_finding_id`. Triggers arbiter dispatch when prior finding was defended.
   - `REFRAME_OF`: re-casts a prior finding with different framing; requires `prior_finding_id` reference.
2. **prior_finding_id rules** — required for RESUSTAIN_OF and REFRAME_OF; must match an ID in `prior_findings.json`; absent for NEW_INTRODUCED unless `escape_rationale` overrides proximity-overlap check.
3. **escape_rationale format** — free-text, max 512 chars. When supplied: MUST reference at least one token or cited-line pattern present in the new finding's diff context but NOT in (a) the prior finding's cited_lines content AND NOT in (b) the ±5-line proximity overlap region. Structural validation is done by the orchestrator without LLM calls. Rationales failing this check are rejected and finding is treated as if no `escape_rationale` was provided.
4. **NEW_INTRODUCED-vs-NEW_PRE_EXISTING semantics** — NEW_INTRODUCED for code in the cycle-N diff delta; NEW_PRE_EXISTING for pre-existing code. Auto-downgrade rule: NEW_PRE_EXISTING → `minor` severity unless prior_finding_id was rated `important` or `critical` (re-elevation of previously-minor findings prohibited without explicit ESCALATE_REVIEW).
5. **Call 2 completeness check protocol** — every finding_id from Call 1 must appear in Call 2 output. Missing IDs trigger one re-dispatch with message "Finding <id> was present in Call 1 but absent from your response; include it with an appropriate relation." Persistently missing findings (still absent after re-dispatch) are carried forward with `relation: NEW_INTRODUCED` as safe default.

## Document Structure
Follow escalate-review-signal.md pattern:
- `# Contract: review-findings-schema`
- Metadata block (Signal Name, Status: accepted, Scope, Date)
- Purpose section
- Signal Name
- Emitter section (cycle-N+1 reviewer Call 2)
- Parser section (review orchestrator)
- Signal Format (findings JSON schema with relation field, prior_finding_id, escape_rationale)
- Field definitions table
- Relation enum table with semantics and validity rules
- Auto-downgrade rule
- Call 2 completeness check protocol
- Example Payload (first-cycle, cycle-N+1 with each relation type)
- Failure Contract
- Consumers table
- Versioning / Change Log

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Contract file exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md
- [ ] Contract file defines all four relation values
  Verify: grep -q "NEW_INTRODUCED" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md && grep -q "NEW_PRE_EXISTING" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md && grep -q "RESUSTAIN_OF" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md && grep -q "REFRAME_OF" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md
- [ ] Contract file defines escape_rationale format
  Verify: grep -q "escape_rationale" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md
- [ ] Contract file defines auto-downgrade rule for NEW_PRE_EXISTING
  Verify: grep -q "auto-downgrade\|auto_downgrade\|NEW_PRE_EXISTING" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md
- [ ] Contract file follows established contract structure (has Purpose and Signal Name sections)
  Verify: grep -q "## Purpose" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md && grep -q "Signal Name" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-findings-schema.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment: 1) Contract MUST enumerate auto-downgrade rule trigger preconditions: NEW_PRE_EXISTING auto-downgrades to 'minor' UNLESS referenced prior_finding_id was previously rated 'important' or 'critical'. List allowed severity transitions. State that downgrade is irreversible within a cycle but a subsequent cycle may re-raise. Require severity_history[] entry on downgrade with reason='auto_downgrade'. 2) Contract MUST add one-line disambiguation note vs review-event-schema.md: 'Scope: finding records and relation taxonomy. For review lifecycle events see review-event-schema.md.' And add reciprocal one-line pointer in review-event-schema.md (can be done in same commit).
